Name: Krobus is the original                       Starwalker from Deltarune (Content Patcher)
Author: Kristherats
Description:
The sweet, sewer-dwelling Krobus has been replaced by a weird little yellow guy. They seem quite irritated by... well anything and everything, but that won't discourage the farmer from talking to them, bringing them gifts, taking them to the movies and maybe even inviting them to live on the farm! 

[b]How to install?[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and unzip "[CP] The Original                                     Starwalker"
[*]Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
This is the first mod I ever made, so all bug reports or advice are greatly appreciated :)
